approval: Explicit root instruction before paired development collection/judgements or any held-out collection
reason: Reconcile the implementation plan’s answerable-category thresholds with deliberately insufficient-evidence scenarios. Preserve raw zero precision and all-case results rather than treating honest adjacent profiles as fabricated expertise or allowing them to inflate nDCG.
scope: Usefulness and nDCG acceptance denominators only. No brief, relevance grade, source expectation, threshold, reference or individual result is changed.
denominator: At least one independently resolved grade 2 or 3 candidate anywhere in the complete pooled union of both releases, all methods and accepted anchors. Identical case eligibility applies to both releases and all retrieval methods.
mandatoryReporting: Raw all-discovery-case P@5 and nDCG summaries remain present.
Report answerable and insufficient-evidence case counts and case IDs.
No useful candidate in the reviewed pool is not proof that none exists in the full corpus.
Insufficient-evidence cases remain subject to interpretation, honest indirect presentation and zero unsupported claim checks.
Incomplete judgements block all metrics. A zero-result run cannot remove a case from the denominator.
